name: AIZO
recent: AIZO Group Berhad 近期宣布其 RM37m 污水工程分包合约被终止，并可能面临索赔。公司同时进行多项企业活动，包括不可赎回可转换优先股（ICPS）到期自动转换为普通股，以及将于2026年11月24日召开第24届年度股东大会。此外，公司仍在探索砂拉越的绿色沥青设施。
notable: AIZO Engineering 的 RM36.79mil 污水项目合约被终止，可能面临索赔。
318,853,347 股 ICPS 到期自动转换为 79,713,321 股新普通股，并于2026年10月29日上市。
公司将于2026年11月24日召开第24届年度股东大会。
risks: 污水项目合约终止后存在未解决的潜在索赔。
独立非执行董事 Lo Ling 在闭锁期內出售了 16,297,200 股（0.733%）。
公司最新季度净亏损 RM5.781 million，净利率为 -14.9%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，公司营收为 RM38.812 million，环比增长11.4%，同比增长4.8%；净亏损为 RM5.781 million，净利率为 -14.9%，而上一季度净利率为 -2.1%。

recent_en: AIZO Group Berhad recently announced the termination of its RM37m sewage subcontract and potential claims. It continues to explore a green bitumen facility in Sarawak.
notable_en: AIZO Engineering's RM36.79mil sewage project contract was terminated, with potential claims.
318,853,347 ICPS automatically converted into 79,713,321 new ordinary shares upon maturity, listed on 29 October 2026.
risks_en: Potential unresolved claims following the termination of the sewage project contract.
Independent Non-Executive Director Lo Ling disposed of 16,297,200 shares (0.733%) during the closed period.
The company reported a net loss of RM5.781 million in the latest quarter, with a net margin of -14.9%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM38.812 million, up 11.4% QoQ and 4.8% YoY; net loss was RM5.781 million with a net margin of -14.9%, compared to -2.1% in the previous quarter.
